material_questions.description: Only questions whose actual author answer is required to choose position, audience or scope; otherwise empty.

core_idea.description: The author's actual idea or open question in plain words, interpreted from exact author input. Not a manufactured thesis; null only when the author supplied a topic without an idea or question.

intended_understanding.description: What the intended reader should be able to understand or accurately restate after reading. Comprehension, not agreement, persuasion or a fixed emotional response.

firsthand_evidence.description: Author-reported experiences or observations, each bound to an exact excerpt from the seed, current revision request or recorded author clarification. Author-reported, not independently inspected.

author_tone.description: Article-specific attitude the author actually supplied, with its exact source excerpt. Null imposes no attitude; never a house style.
